13-1.title: Small Three Dragons
13-1.subtitle: Two dragon triplets plus a dragon pair

dialogues.speaker: mj
dialogues.text: Small Three Dragons 小三元 looks bigger than it pays. Two dragons arrive as triplets, and the third dragon becomes your pair.

dialogues.speaker: mj
dialogues.text: The pattern itself is 3 faan. Each of those two dragon triplets still counts 1 faan on top, so the hand settles at 5.

dialogues.speaker: you
dialogues.text: So {{red}}{{red}}{{red}} and {{green}}{{green}}{{green}}, with {{white}}{{white}} sitting as the eyes?

dialogues.speaker: mj
dialogues.text: Exactly. Notice the pair earns nothing extra, because dragon eyes are still just eyes.

dialogues.speaker: mj
dialogues.text: Five faan pays 24 from a discarder. Respectable, but nowhere near the 10-faan ceiling.

questions.question: How many dragon triplets does Small Three Dragons 小三元 require?
questions.explanation: 小三元 uses two dragons as triplets; the third dragon is kept as the pair, which is exactly what makes it small.

questions.question: Small Three Dragons 小三元 is worth how many faan before the two dragon triplets are added?
questions.explanation: The pattern alone is 3 faan, and the dragon triplets are counted afterwards as separate 1-faan items.

questions.question: In 小三元, what is the third dragon used for?
options: The pair that becomes the eyes
questions.explanation: The remaining dragon is paired and used as the eyes; if all three dragons were triplets the hand would be 大三元.

questions.question: Which statements about Small Three Dragons 小三元 are true?
options: Two of the three dragons form triplets
The third dragon forms the pair
The dragon pair used as eyes adds another faan
questions.explanation: Two triplets plus a dragon pair is the shape. The pair is only the eyes and earns no faan, and three dragon triplets would be 大三元.

questions.question: Your hand already holds {{red}}{{red}}{{red}} and {{green}}{{green}}{{green}}. Which tile has to be the pair for 小三元?
questions.explanation: With 紅中 and 發財 already spent on triplets, only 白板 is left to sit as the dragon pair.

questions.question: Match each part of a dragon hand to what it is worth.

pairs.left: Two dragon triplets plus one dragon pair
A dragon pair sitting as the eyes

questions.explanation: The two dragon triplets each add 1 faan to the 3-faan pattern, while the pair is only the eyes and is never scored.

questions.question: Counting the pattern and both dragon triplets, Small Three Dragons 小三元 collects how many faan in total?
questions.explanation: 3 faan for the pattern plus 1 faan for each dragon triplet gives 5 faan.

questions.question: A 5-faan hand is won on a discard. How much does the discarder pay?
questions.explanation: On the payment table 5 faan is 24 points from the discarder, who pays the whole amount alone.

13-2.title: Great Three Dragons
13-2.subtitle: All three dragons, and who pays

dialogues.speaker: mj
dialogues.text: Great Three Dragons 大三元 is the louder cousin: all three dragons come as triplets, so no dragon is left for the pair.

dialogues.speaker: mj
dialogues.text: The pattern is 5 faan, and the three dragon triplets add 3 more, which makes 8.

dialogues.speaker: you
dialogues.text: Eight faan. And there is a payment rule attached to this one, right?

dialogues.speaker: mj
dialogues.text: There is. 大三元包 means the player who fed you the third dragon triplet pays your whole self-draw on their own.

dialogues.speaker: mj
dialogues.text: The exception: if that third triplet was a concealed kong, nobody supplied it, so the self-draw goes back to the normal three-way split.

questions.question: You hold {{red}}{{red}}{{red}} and {{green}}{{green}}{{green}}. Which tile must you now collect a triplet of to reach Great Three Dragons 大三元?
questions.explanation: 大三元 needs all three dragons as triplets, so the missing third dragon is 白板.

questions.question: With all three dragons used as triplets, what serves as the eyes in 大三元?
options: Any other pair, for example a number tile pair
questions.explanation: All three dragons are spent on triplets, so the eyes must come from somewhere else in the hand.

questions.question: What is Great Three Dragons 大三元 worth before the three dragon triplets are counted?
questions.explanation: The pattern is 5 faan on its own, and the dragon triplets are added as separate 1-faan items.

questions.question: Adding the three dragon triplets to the pattern, 大三元 collects how many faan in total?
questions.explanation: 5 faan for the pattern plus 1 faan for each of the three dragon triplets makes 8 faan.

questions.question: Under 大三元包, who pays when the winner self-draws?
options: The player who supplied the third dragon triplet
The dealer, whatever seat they hold
The player who discarded the first dragon tile
questions.explanation: The 包 liability lands on the single player whose deal completed the third dragon triplet, and they pay the entire self-draw.

questions.question: When does the 大三元包 liability not apply?
options: When the third dragon triplet was completed as a concealed kong
When the hand wins on a discard
When the winner happens to be the dealer
When the third dragon triplet was exposed
questions.explanation: A concealed kong is built from the winner's own tiles, so nobody supplied the third set and the self-draw is shared normally.

questions.question: Which statements about Great Three Dragons 大三元 are true?
options: The three dragon triplets add 3 faan
It needs a dragon pair for its eyes
questions.explanation: 5 plus 3 makes 8 faan, which sits below the 10-faan ceiling, and no dragon is left over for the pair.

questions.question: Match each situation to the correct outcome.

pairs.left: Two dragon triplets and one dragon pair
Third dragon triplet completed by a discard
pairs.right: The supplier of that triplet pays the whole self-draw

pairs.left: Third dragon triplet made as a concealed kong
pairs.right: No one pays the self-draw alone, all three share it

questions.explanation: The count and the payment liability both follow from how the third dragon triplet was completed.

13-3.title: Small Four Winds
13-3.subtitle: Three wind triplets, one wind pair

dialogues.speaker: mj
dialogues.text: Now the winds. Small Four Winds 小四喜 is a limit hand, so it is worth a flat 10 faan.

dialogues.speaker: mj
dialogues.text: Three winds form triplets and the fourth wind waits as your pair: four winds, three sets.

dialogues.speaker: mj
dialogues.text: That is the shape. Because 10 is the ceiling, your 自摸 or your seat wind cannot push it any higher.

dialogues.speaker: mj
dialogues.text: Turn that spare {{north}}{{north}} into a triplet and you have 大四喜, still 10 faan, so there is no reward for the extra work.

questions.question: How many wind triplets does Small Four Winds 小四喜 need?
questions.explanation: Three winds are triplets or kongs, and the fourth wind is left over to form the pair.

questions.question: What role does the fourth wind play in 小四喜?
options: It becomes the pair, the eyes
questions.explanation: Four winds but only three sets: the leftover wind pairs up and serves as the eyes.

questions.question: How much is Small Four Winds 小四喜 worth?
questions.explanation: 小四喜 is an 例牌 hand, and every limit hand is scored as a flat 10 faan.

questions.question: Which statements about Small Four Winds 小四喜 are true?
options: Only three of the four winds count as triplets
The fourth wind is the pair
The wind pair used as eyes adds 2 faan on top
questions.explanation: Three wind triplets plus a wind pair is the shape and the hand is limited to 10 faan; the pair is only the eyes and adds nothing.

questions.question: Your hand shows {{east}}{{east}}{{east}}, {{south}}{{south}}{{south}} and {{west}}{{west}}{{west}}. Which tile must be the pair for 小四喜?
questions.explanation: 東, 南 and 西 are already used as triplets, so 北 is the only wind left to pair up.

questions.question: Match each hand shape to its name and value.

pairs.left: Three wind triplets plus a wind pair

questions.explanation: The extra wind triplet upgrades the name but not the score, because both four-wind hands are limit hands.

questions.question: On a self-draw, a 10-faan hand collects how many points from each of the other three players?
questions.explanation: The top row of the payment table is 128 from a discarder and 64 from each player on a self-draw.

questions.question: A 小四喜 hand also has 自摸 and a seat wind. How is it scored?
options: A flat 10 faan, because that is the ceiling
questions.explanation: Limit hands are flat 10 faan, so 自摸 and wind faan are not added on top.
